name: What is an open-concept kitchen, and how does it differ from a traditional kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What is an open-concept kitchen, and how does it differ from a traditional kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: An open-concept kitchen integrates the cooking area with adjacent living spaces, such as the dining room or living room, by removing walls or creating large openings. This design contrasts with traditional kitchens that typically feature enclosed spaces with distinct walls separating them from other rooms. One practical tradeoff is that while it enhances social interaction and natural light, it may reduce available wall space for cabinetry and require careful consideration of noise and odor transfer.
acceptedAnswer.description: An open-concept kitchen merges the cooking area with living spaces by removing walls, unlike traditional enclosed kitchens. It fosters interaction but may reduce cabinet space.
